scope: Prospective evidence only; immutable source context, no computation, physical procedure, scientific acceptance or remote action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Prescribed whole inventory versus cell and article boundaries
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md What is still missing entirely; docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md Both directions
entries.units: configuration identity; enclosed volume m3; pressure Pa; inventory identity
entries.method: Request a matched architecture, cell inventory, enclosed-volume and pressure-state record, identifying the individual cell, neighbours and complete article with source and uncertainty provenance.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Historical whole-ship energy context is not an individual-cell response or a current measured inventory. Source quantities are not recomputed or transferred.

entries.units: pressure Pa; time s; deformation m; response identity
entries.method: Request synchronized raw pressure and response records for a matched article/configuration and declared failure state, with calibration, clock basis and uncertainty.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The E4 cell-local loss statement is an architectural hypothesis, not demonstrated benign failure or an adopted quantitative threshold. No failure procedure is prescribed. E4 names the Stage B article cycled to failure as its intended source test; this source statement is neither prescribed, performed nor configuration-matched here.

entries.units: cell/interface identity; pressure differential Pa; response time s; deformation m
entries.method: Request neighbour/partition configuration and matched pressure/response histories with time alignment and uncertainty, identifying any propagation, lost observations and failed cases.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The source calls sudden pressure arrival on nominal zero-differential partitions unmodelled. Steady-state response or one-cell evidence cannot establish transient propagation limits.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Containment, debris and full-article consequence boundaries
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md E4 — breach; What is still missing entirely
entries.units: component/record identity; position m; time s; observed response units UNKNOWN
entries.method: Request identified containment interfaces and raw observations of structural/material response and debris location with a matched article/state, coverage, calibration and uncertainty.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: No containment/mitigation design is selected. A source cellularity claim does not establish debris containment, complete-article behaviour or safety.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Current installed article and load-state provenance
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md Recorded disagreements; docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Breach hand figures without a generator
entries.units: component identity; geometry m; pressure Pa; source/load-case identity
entries.method: Request complete architecture, barrier/joint/partition/attachment identities and the actual pressure/load state with source versions and explicit missing interfaces; keep drawing and bill discrepancies.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Hand figures lack a generated reproducible comparison and material/load-case basis. Named/drawn parts and unresolved bills are not a qualified installed failure configuration. E4 names the Stage B article cycled to failure as its intended source test; this source statement is neither prescribed, performed nor configuration-matched here.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Source hypothesis, criteria ownership and raw-evidence disposition
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md E4 — breach; docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Breach hand figures without a generator
entries.units: record identity; uncertainty units per quantity; synchronization error s
entries.method: Request raw calibrated matched records, processing versions, uncertainty/correlations and failure/missing-data flags; identify any later criterion and acceptance decision separately.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: E4 names cell-local rather than shipwide loss as the hypothesis to examine. No adopted quantified breach/propagation/containment criterion or physical acceptance is supplied here.
